answer: By the cedar of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The garden holds work receipts rather than names, so the walnut of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
